text:
Lina Gomez: tiny idea  quick holiday postcard swap? send a card (digital or paper) to one coworker, we'll pair people and share addresses if you opt in. stickers encouraged. :postcard:
Owen Park: yes please. i have a stack of vintage-looking postcards ive been hoarding. count me in. :vintage:
Priya N.: can we do a safe option for folks not comfortable sharing addresses? like digital-only or office drop-off? :+1:
Lina Gomez: absolutely. options: 1) paper mail (share address privately to organizer) 2) office drop (leave at mailroom w/ name) 3) digital postcard (img/file + message). pick in the sign-up form. :sparkles:
Theo: signup link (one-question form): https://tinyurl.com/redwood-postcard23 
Rina (they/them): love it. also - sticker swap add-on? i can trade a holo snowflake for a cocoa sticker. :snowflake:
mailroom-bot: Reminder: if dropping at mailroom, label "Postcard Swap" + recipient name. Mailroom open 9am-4pm Mon-Fri.
Owen Park: note for internationals: i'll happily send digital cards across borders if postage is a pain.
Priya N.: preference: digital or office drop. not comfortable sharing home mailing address, thx. :relieved:
Lina Gomez: totally fine! the organizer (me) will only collect addresses for paper mail and won't keep them after pairing - i'll dm you the details when signups close.
Rina (they/them): question: deadline?
Lina Gomez: signups close in 48 hours, pairing out the next day, send-by date Dec 20.
Theo: tiny template for messages if anyone's awkward about writing: "Happy holidays! hope your end of year is cozy. - [your name]" feel free to add a doodle.
Owen Park: i will absolutely add a terrible doodle of a llama wearing a scarf. consider this a warning. :llama:
mailroom-bot: Signup tally: 23 people (8 paper mail, 7 office drop, 8 digital).
Priya N.: yay math. also can we have a "kudos sticker" for someone who goes above and beyond? like, include a sticky note shoutout in the postcard.
Lina Gomez: love that. postcard shoutouts encouraged. little kindnesses only. :heart:
Rina (they/them): thanks for organizing @Lina! excited to make a tiny paper mess.
Owen Park: same. and yes to stickers. if anyone wants to swap physical sticker packs, dm me.
Lina Gomez: pairing done! i've dmed everyone their match and delivery preferences. if you didn't get a dm, ping me. enjoy crafting and optional sticker trading :sparkles:
